stmt: Lawful gun ownership is a legitimate individual right.
Charitable giving is preferable to state-run welfare.
Healthcare should be provided free by the government to everyone.
The free market allocates resources better than government does.
Government is generally the problem rather than the solution.
Large corporations should face much stricter regulation.
The military budget should be significantly reduced.
Economic growth matters more than reducing inequality.
Housing should be treated as a right provided by the state.
Social spending should increase even if taxes must rise.
Law and order should be prioritized over reforming the police.
Billionaires should not be allowed to exist.
Free enterprise has lifted more people out of poverty than aid programs.
Prisons should focus on rehabilitation rather than punishment.
Wealth should be redistributed from the rich to the poor.
Student debt should be cancelled by the government.
Inheritance tax should be abolished.
International institutions should have more authority over nations.
Affirmative action programs are unfair.
National sovereignty should take precedence over international agreements.
